evidence.excerpt:
Everything in Eigenius is aResource(IRI identity, class-membership
claims, typed properties), extending Atomic Data [17] with a de-
pendent type system and institution machinery. The ontology is
self-describing; schema and data are unified, so declaring a class
simply means committing a resource. The unit of commit is alayer—
an immutable resource set with a parent pointer. Layer identity
is content-addressed (SHA-256 of canonical CBOR [9]), forming a
Merkle commitment to graph history where class resolution walks
the chain.
Why a database type theory differs from a proof assistant's.The
kernel's native calculus,EigenTT[ 3], is a dependent type theory
with a cumulative universe hierarchy ( Prop=Sort 0 <Set=
Sort 1 <Type 𝑘 with impredicative Prop), inductive families, and
intensional identity types. Serving as a persistent knowledge-graph
kernel rather than an interactive proof assistant

conversion would erase
provenance at the kernel level and reduce the proof calculus
to boolean entailment [3]. EigenTT keeps conversion on Prop
intensional and supplies proof irrelevance only as an explicit
axiom (irrel), so distinct proof and justification terms remain
distinct, inspectable chain resources.
Branches and merges make the layer history a lattice whose joins
are typed merges (Witness, Rename, SchemaQuotient, Restructure),
acting as chain-level functorial data migrations [ 8] (theory mor-
phisms inTh).
Epistemic stratification as a justification logic.A prover dis-
charges a mathematical claim because its leaves are axioms; a
scientific claim's leaves are observations and conventions — an
instrument reading, a chosen 𝛼 — that no prover can discharge.
So the kernel checks the composition while the grade records
what stands behind each leaf: a justification logicJ [3, 19]

evidence.excerpt:
To integrate external reasoners (ODE solvers, theorem provers) into
a DBMS, the standard tool is the stored procedure. Because stored
procedures assume a flat relational world, Eigenius introducesinsti-
tutions[ 4] as a strongly typed generalization for knowledge graphs.
Three institutional levels and witness transport.Classical Goguen–
Burstall institutions [4] and𝜋-institutions [6] model satisfaction (|=)
or consequence (⊢) as a boolean relation, forgettingwhya sentence
holds. To persist witnesses alongside claims, Eigenius organizes
hosted logics at three levels [3]: (1) at thewitness level(the commit
path), each reasoner is a Meseguerproof calculus[ 5] assigning
to each theory 𝑇 a category of witnesses P(𝑇) projecting onto
sentences via𝜋𝑇 ; (2) forgetting witnesses yields a𝜋-institution at
theconsequence level; and (3) the canonical G-construction yields
a standard institution

methods: extract_typed,
reify, and query. A comorphism pipeline extracts a payload of type
𝑆, applies𝑚 :𝑆→𝑇 , and reifies output𝑇 into a target resource.
At commit, the kernel statically type-checks that 𝑚's signature
matches payload(export)→payload(import) ; type-incorrect trans-
lations are rejected like schema violations. Institutions run either
out-of-core in containers (Julia/R) or in-process inside the kernel
binary (Lean 4).
Justification and statistics as pluggable logic.The epistemic grad-
ing from §3 is not hardwired into the engine; justification logic itself
is an attached institution. The replication in §6 demonstrates this
by composing two pluggable reasoners. First, astatistics institution
connects empirical computation to the commit path. It fires on a
committed statistical-analysis plan—a recipe, not a claim:
resource wrn:wrn_dep_plan
: stats:StatisticalAnalysisPlan

Materializing the boundary: durable translations.In traditional
federated databases or reasoning orchestrators (like Hets [ 10]),
cross-system translations are ephemeral: computed in volatile
memory to bridge a gap, then discarded. Because Eigenius treats
both schemas and proofs as typed graph resources, a crossing's
warranty—its typed translation—is just data. The reify step's
output (Figure 1) is not a transport-only intermediate; it isma-
terializedback into the chain at a deterministic content-hash IRI
(urn:eigenius:comorphism-output:tail:hex), or at a caller-named
IRI under an INTO clause. Identical translations naturally dedupli-
cate via content addressing; commit-time triggers fire on the newly
materialized translation; and downstream queries pattern-match
it exactly like native data.

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: The headline empirical outcome is established by recomputing a published Nature study from hash-pinned source data, an external benchmark independent of the system's own design and formalization.
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Recomputation of the Chan et al. Nature study from pinned data, plus ingestion throughput metrics on WordNet and UMLS.
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: Manual kernel, schema, and protocol design; Lean 4 mechanization of the system's own metatheory.

primary.claim_evidence_alignment: Claims regarding commit-time epistemic invariants, witness durability, and multi-system integration are well supported by the implementation details, formal system descriptions, and the execution of the macro-replication study.
primary.evaluation_assessment: Evaluation includes mechanized metatheory referenced in a companion monograph, an ingestion throughput microbenchmark demonstrating roughly 5,200 validated resources per second on 9.19M entries, and an end-to-end empirical replication of a published Nature study (Chan et al.) recomputing 52 derived conclusions while surfacing four discrepancies.

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: The external benchmark of re-running the complete statistical and analytical pipeline of the Chan et al. study directly against original source data verified 52 of 52 conclusions while identifying four previously undetected discrepancies.
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Empirical recomputation of pinned data from an independent Nature study (Chan et al.) alongside ingestion throughput metrics across UMLS and WordNet.
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: Rule-based system construction, manual kernel and schema design, and static Lean 4 formalization specifications.

primary.limitations: The authors transparently note limitations, including shifting from Wasm sandboxing to container isolation, an open strong-normalization proof for full kernel termination, the uncharacterized status of general pushouts across conflicting branches, and unclosed autonomous loops for AI agents.
primary.method_assessment: The architectural and theoretical design is clearly described, distinguishing database type checking from proof-assistant equality via separation of conversion from subtyping and retaining axiomatic proof irrelevance to preserve audit warrants. External reasoning and verification are mediated via institutional comorphisms, an in-process Rust term checker for Lean 4 proofs, and a shared intermediate representation that reduces polystore adapters.
primary.quality_rationale: The manuscript makes a well-articulated, substantive systems and formal-methods contribution. The design choices are thoroughly justified, the implementation is evaluated across both synthetic scale benchmarks and a complex real-world scientific workflow, and theoretical boundaries and ongoing work are explicitly demarcated.
primary.scoped_contribution: The manuscript presents Eigenius, an open-source typed knowledge-graph DBMS integrating dependent type theory (EigenTT), an epistemic stratification lattice backed by justification logic, and a three-level institutional framework with witness transport comorphisms to turn scientific provenance into commit-enforced invariants.

scholarly_quality.rationale: The manuscript makes a well-articulated, substantive systems and formal-methods contribution. The design choices are thoroughly justified, the implementation is evaluated across both synthetic scale benchmarks and a complex real-world scientific workflow, and theoretical boundaries and ongoing work are explicitly demarcated.
scholarly_quality.uncertainty: The authors transparently note limitations, including shifting from Wasm sandboxing to container isolation, an open strong-normalization proof for full kernel termination, the uncharacterized status of general pushouts across conflicting branches, and unclosed autonomous loops for AI agents.
